card.title: PixelGrasp
lines: A robot arm learns pick-and-place from a camera only.
Run 1 of the sprint: behaviour cloning, 2,000 demos, 15 epochs
Dev success 30%  -  run 2 (action chunking, 4,900 demos) training now

card.title: What you just saw
lines: Left: a scripted expert that reads the cube position from the simulator (100/100).
Right: a ResNet-18 that sees ONLY a 96x96 camera frame + its own gripper pose.
+ green = cube delivered to the red target within 50 steps
- red = failure, with the reason the eval harness assigned
card.footer: Every number comes from eval.py on 100 frozen held-out scenes

card.title: Next: run 2
lines: Predict 8 future moves at once (action chunking) and re-plan every 4
4,900 demonstrations, 20 epochs, ~70 min on the laptop GPU
Then: ablations, failure taxonomy, README, VERIFY.md
